findings.claim: Generated formatters for types from a referenced assembly use the generated Deserialize path, which does not appear to call options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) or use MessagePackSecurity hash-collision-resistant comparers in the new path. Deserialization of attacker-controlled input recursing through self-referential contractless members (e.g. a Node with Node-typed members) is only bounded if the template emits reader.Depth/DepthStep. The new collector builds ObjectSerializationInfo with nestedFormatterRequired false and no verification. The templates were not changed to guarantee DepthStep, so this relies on existing template behavior.

receipt_plan.detail: Generate a formatter for a self-referential class via [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter]; inspect the output for options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) in Deserialize, and run a deserialization test with deeply nested data under MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData expecting InsufficientExecutionStackException/MessagePackSerializationException rather than a StackOverflow.
